purpose: Indicate an approximate amount or duration.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
Please wait here for about ten minutes.
I walked about two kilometers from the station.
restrictions: Here ばかり means approximately, rather than only or just finished.
mistake: Do not read an approximate quantity as a strict limit.

segments.role: Indicate an approximate amount or duration. Quantity + ばかり
